findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

The observed learning window is the score-time interval 0.0 to 0.5 with 50 observed score nodes, and the curve support is the same interval; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so no absolute affinity label is observed.

Across the read continuous-trend rows, no polynomial fit is accepted and extrapolation is disallowed; the observed-node linear method is used, so any time-conditioned contrast rule must be restricted to the observed support rather than extrapolated.

The read landmark features show multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts within the window (e.g. landmark_00_soft_mass has 4 sign changes and 1 strong conflict; landmark_00_local_dx has 6 sign changes and 9 strong conflicts), so a constant-sign rule is not supported and a time-conditioned rule is the better-supported form.

First-rate and last-rate z values for the same feature frequently disagree in sign (e.g. landmark_00_soft_mass first_rate_z positive and last_rate_z negative; landmark_00_local_dx first_rate_z negative and last_rate_z positive), indicating rate changes across the observed support rather than a single stable trend.

Whole-window z values for the read features are small in magnitude relative to the endpoint rate z values, so the integrated whole-window contrast is weak even where local rates are large; point-estimate ranking alone would overstate these features.

hypotheses.falsifier: no improvement in observed-node fit fidelity or sign-change tracking relative to a constant rule within the observed window
hypotheses.observable: landmark contrast value at observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast over the observed score window, using validated observed-node interpolation of the landmark contrast functions, will track the observed sign changes better than a constant contrast rule.

hypotheses.falsifier: first-rate and last-rate z agree in sign for the feature under a validated fit
hypotheses.scope: read landmark features in the observed window
hypotheses.statement: Features whose first-rate and last-rate z disagree in sign are candidates for a within-window rate change rather than a stable monotone trend.

limitations: Only six continuous_trends rows were read; the remaining 194 rows and the other tables (branch_adjusted, endpoint_effects, increment_effects, joint_diagnostics, lineage_support, regional_effects, survival_effects, turnover_accounting, information_audit, curve_support) were not inspected, so no claim about them is made.
No decoded terminal labels or final affinity outcomes are supplied, so last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
The read features are predicted_endpoint_world_A coordinate features; they are not physical interaction energies and do not establish neural-module causation.
No temperature edit is proposed or permitted; temperatures are immutable task parameters.

task.formula: R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau), q=detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance; rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). Actual pointcloud_delta_A defaults to 1 A. Native endpoint VJP, no affinity-head derivative, no extra model forward. teacher_neighbors is a count; temporal_recipe changes only a registered scalar/attention, not velocity. No temperature edits. Inert legacy metadata is not a reward term.

formula_registry.diagnostic_limit: Moment effects, pair kernels and turnover are diagnostic evidence. Executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is inert.
formula_registry.dose: Endpoint-VJP force normalized and RMS-scaled against native predictive update; eta/ramp only in U lane.
formula_registry.prior: Detached nearest-k teachers; log_pi=-q_anchor/prior_temperature; scores beta=0; k is a count.
formula_registry.regional: Detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention; positive surrounding weight.
formula_registry.temporal_region: Same static teachers; validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.
formula_registry.temporal_teacher: (1-blend)*R_static + blend*R_observed_teacher(time); same shared FLOWR endpoint, no velocity target.

incumbent.topology_policy: Free native graph transitions; no pair-distance acceptance or graph equality veto

task.objective: Final predicted target affinity primary; validity and strain secondary; coordinate control only
task.task_wording: Use these observations to provide your response to the supplied molecular coordinate task.
